# pretender

> Rust CLI for structural code-quality checks across multiple languages. Enforces architectural constraints and naming conventions without requiring a build system.

## Authorship

All code in this repository was generated by a large language model. Human contribution: requirements, design decisions, planning, and review.

Leer en español: https://charly-vibes.github.io/charly-vibes/

## Agent integration

- `docs/agent-integration.md` — templates for making pretender discoverable
  in CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, llm.txt, and justfile

## Genesis adoption

pretender adopts all 14 genesis v0.4.0 modules to avoid reimplementing
shared suite infrastructure:

- `aix` — AIX artifact generation (agents_block helper)
- `cli` — completions, version-json pre-parse
- `config` — shared ConfigFile/ConfigStore/ConfigRegistry
- `discovery` — .genesis/tools.toml manifest registration
- `doctor` — structured diagnostics (DoctorCheck/DoctorReport/DoctorRunner)
- `envelope` — structured JSON output (Envelope/EnvelopeKind)
- `feedback` — agent issue reporting
- `fixture` — test scratch environments (Fixture/FixtureBuilder)
- `guide` — CLI scaffold and error handling (Guide/OutputFormat/Verbosity)
- `managed_block` — AGENTS.md managed block injection
- `scaffold` — init scaffolding (Scaffold)
- `status` — cross-tool dashboard (StatusContributor/StatusItem)
- `suggestions` — typo correction and self-healing error footers
- `suite_linter` — suite-wide lint checks (LintResult/Severity)
